integrity_note: Finite census and signed-matrix certificate reproducible using included standard-library Python code; general theorem follows from a mathematical total-unimodularity integrality argument. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Universal subsampling guarantee only for at most three strict complete alternatives; four-alternative impossibility only for selecting original voters, not arbitrary synthetic rankings; exact census only for four-voter two-representative profiles. Unindexed equivalent results remain possible.
title: Sharp three-to-four-alternative boundary for input-only pairwise proportional ranking compression
